messages:
Nora: quick heads-up  found a small but customer-visible mismatch: some SDKs send routing info as headers (Route-Policy) while others put it in the JSON body (route_policy). console attribution only reads body first -> headers ignored
Ike: example payloads?
Nora: header form: Route-Policy: team=payments; body form: {"route_policy": {"team": "payments"}}
Pavel: ah that explains the silent quota drift we saw for Tenant-42 last night. traces showed correct header but console didn't pick it up
Jay: short-term mitigation: add an ingress shim that merges header->body and tags events with migration=header-to-body so we can track how many clients use headers
Ike: +1. also add a small reconciliation script to backfill missing attribution for the last 48h where header-only requests likely misattributed
Nora: SDK owners: propose canonical form is body map (route_policy object). header support will be deprecated but we should allow header passthrough for one release while clients upgrade
Pavel: timeline? I can land the shim today and canary at 5% this afternoon. will add metric route_input_variant and a per-tenant alert if unattributed > 0.5%
Jay: SDK patches: TS/Go to prefer body, but if configured with preferHeaders=true keep header behavior. Include a one-time WARN when preferHeaders is used so customers notice deprecation
Ike: console: add a rollup tile that merges header-derived and body-derived policy counts so charts don't drop during rollout. add migration tag to traces
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: ingress-header-merge-canary -> 2026-03-24 16:00 PT, 5% traffic, id: d-50500-canary
Pavel: canary started. watching quota.unattributed and route_input_variant. ping here when canary hits 50%
Nora: thanks team. once SDKs release we'll keep shim for 2 weeks and then remove header passthrough. will write a short note for #devex with code snippets and upgrade guidance
